## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Market shows broad sector participation (7/11) but risk/cycle ratios are flat — VXX neutral and SPY_TLT neutral — producing a neutral tilt rather than a decisive risk-on or risk-off.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Volatility: VXX (1W: +3.66% | 1M: +4.64%) ABOVE TREND — modest near-term pickup in realized/expected vol. Credit: HYG (1W: -0.02% | 1M: +0.51%) CORRECTION and LQD (1W: -0.24% | 1M: -0.08%) BELOW TREND — credit signals overall neutral.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral: SPY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +0.72%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: -0.91% | 1M: -0.83%) BELOW TREND leaves SPY/TLT effectively flat in the regime matrix; dollar and curve reported as neutral in market ratios.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Cyclicals/Commodity-linked leadership: XLE (1W: +3.78% | 1M: +13.55%) ABOVE TREND and Energy-related ETFs showing strength while XLK (1W: -0.83% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND. XLF (1W: +0.70% | 1M: -3.15%) in RECOVERY — style: Value/cyclicals favored over Growth for now.

**5. US vs Global?**
US broad market steady: SPY (1W: +0.40% | 1M: +0.72%) ABOVE TREND while QQQ (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +0.39%) in CORRECTION and IWM (1W: -1.95% | 1M: +4.68%) in CORRECTION — EM holding up: EEM (1W: +0.05% | 1M: +7.69%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +2.43%) ABOVE TREND.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Weakening speculative demand: ARKK (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -3.85%) BELOW TREND and IBIT (1W: -6.33% | 1M: -4.70%) BELOW TREND point to cooling thematic and crypto flows; small-cap momentum mixed with IWM in CORRECTION.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Commodity bifurcation: UNG (1W: +20.97% | 1M: +28.81%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +7.36% | 1M: +15.53%) ABOVE TREND driving raw-material strength, while GLD (1W: -2.85% | 1M: +11.55%) in CORRECTION — gold profit-taking within a longer monthly uptrend.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy clear leader: XLE (1W: +3.78% | 1M: +13.55%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +14.02%) ABOVE TREND; natural gas surge via UNG ABOVE TREND is a standout.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Energy/commodities (XLE, USO, BNO) show consistent 1W and 1M strength. DIVERGENCE: major 1W vs 1M mismatches across multiple ETFs (URA, XME, GLD, SLV, XLB) and core divergences among SPY, XLK, XLF, TLT — this is a MAJOR divergence, so strong regime calls are suppressed and the market reads as transitional.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to energy/commodity-linked ETFs (XLE (1W: +3.78% | 1M: +13.55%) ABOVE TREND, BNO (1W: +7.36% | 1M: +15.53%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor cyclical leadership; reduce exposure to high-beta thematic/crypto ETFs (ARKK, IBIT) which are BELOW TREND while bonds remain mixed (LQD (1W: -0.24% | 1M: -0.08%) BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +3.78% | 1M: +13.55%) ABOVE TREND — energy continuation if oil/commodities hold. BEARISH: XLK (1W: -0.83% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND — watch for further tech consolidation.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: UNG (1W: +20.97% | 1M: +28.81%) ABOVE TREND and USO (1W: +7.53% | 1M: +14.02%) ABOVE TREND — momentum favors energy/commodities. BEARISH: PPLT (1W: -22.68% | 1M: -1.80%) BELOW TREND and GLD (1W: -2.85% | 1M: +11.55%) in CORRECTION — watch for continued metal volatility.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX (1W: +3.66% | 1M: +4.64%) ABOVE TREND — watch ~20 for volatility regime shift; HYG/LQD neutral (HYG (1W: -0.02% | 1M: +0.51%) CORRECTION, LQD (1W: -0.24% | 1M: -0.08%) BELOW TREND) — watch credit for decomposition; XLK vs XLF spread to monitor style pivot (XLK (1W: -0.83% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND vs XLF (1W: +0.70% | 1M: -3.15%) RECOVERY).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL — Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, but risk/cycle ratios are flat so no clear market direction. Energy and commodity-linked ETFs (XLE, BNO, UNG) are showing strength. Key risk is a major divergence across core ETFs (SPY, XLK, XLF, TLT) and weakness in thematic/crypto ETFs (ARKK, IBIT) to monitor.
